tell: Cigarette smoking cuts this EGFR inhibitor's AUC by 64%, while food raises its bioavailability to about 100%.

clues.text: About 60% is absorbed orally, and food raises bioavailability to approximately 100%. It is 93% bound to plasma proteins and is mainly cleared by CYP3A4 metabolism.
A hydrochloride salt with a molecular weight of 393.4 for the active moiety. It is very slightly soluble in water.
Tablets in 25, 100 and 150 mg strengths, approved under an NDA.
No boxed warning. Rash and diarrhea are the most common adverse reactions.
Metastatic non-small cell lung cancer whose tumors have specific activating mutations, and metastatic pancreatic cancer in combination with gemcitabine.
It reversibly inhibits the kinase activity of EGFR, preventing autophosphorylation and downstream signaling. Its binding is tighter to mutant EGFR than to the wild-type receptor.
The generic name begins with E and has nine letters.
